title: Discord (send messages)
description: Sends a flow's message to a Discord channel through a bot: a message.send connector, the last step of a flow that runs on its own. Text only.
setup_notes: Create an application at discord.com/developers/applications, add a Bot and copy its token. Invite the bot to your server with the Send Messages permission (OAuth2 > URL Generator, scope bot). Turn on Developer Mode in Discord's settings, then right-click the channel and Copy Channel ID. The credential lands disabled: enable it under API Credentials. The connector lands unapproved: approve it in Admin > Extensions > Connectors and run Test on its row, which posts a short test message. Then use it as a flow's message.send step.

questions.name: bot_token
questions.label: Bot token
questions.help: Write it as Bot followed by a space and the token: Bot MTA1... Stored in the credential's secret store, never in the connector.

questions.name: name
questions.label: Connector name
questions.help: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores; a flow's step names it.

questions.name: channel
questions.label: Channel id
questions.help: Where messages go unless a flow's step says otherwise (its to input): the long number Copy Channel ID gives.

recipe.name: discord_send
recipe.description: Discord bot token, for sending messages.
